01-distinguishability: A measurement strategy and a proof of optimality are separate achievements. For binary minimum-error discrimination, the positive eigenspace of \(p\rho-(1-p)\sigma\) gives both.
With equal priors, \(p_{\mathrm{guess}}=(1+T)/2\), where \(T=\|\rho-\sigma\|_1/2\). This gives trace distance its operational meaning.
For two pure states, \(T=\sqrt{1-F}\). Mixed states require inequalities; throughout this course F denotes squared fidelity.
A deterministic channel cannot improve the best input test. Conditioning on a selected outcome changes the task and requires accounting for its success probability.
An asymmetric test minimizes false alarms subject to a miss constraint. Its optimal effect need not be a projector.
02-quantum-channels: Complete positivity tests consistency with a reference system.
Our unnormalized Choi matrix obeys \(\tr_B J=I_A\).
Kraus operators, Choi matrices, and dilations describe the same channel; device accuracy requires specifying an input model.
03-entropy-and-data-processing: Relative entropy requires a support check and is not a symmetric distance.
Data processing implies strong subadditivity and monotonicity of mutual information.
Error exponents concern a specified many-copy task; they are not exact finite-sample probabilities.
04-entanglement-transformations: LOCC defines which operations are free; a conversion statement must identify its resources.
Pure-state deterministic conversion requires \(\lambda_{\rm input}\prec\lambda_{\rm output}\).
Exact one-copy conversion, probabilistic filtering, and asymptotic rates are different tasks.
05-quantum-compression: Typicality turns entropy into a high-probability subspace dimension.
Quantum compression must preserve coherence and reference correlations.
The entropy rate is asymptotic; finite blocks require explicit dimension and fidelity calculations.
06-classical-communication: The Holevo bound follows from data processing on a classical–quantum state.
Accessible information, optimized one-use Holevo information, and unrestricted capacity are distinct.
Always state encoding restrictions, decoding error, and assistance when reporting a rate.
07-quantum-communication: Coherent information compares the receiver with the environment.
Decoupling concerns the reference–environment joint state, not only their marginals.
Assistance changes capacities; special channel formulas must not be generalized without proof.
08-recovery-and-error-correction: Knill–Laflamme conditions test all cross products of the specified errors.
The repetition code corrects single bit flips, not arbitrary single-qubit noise.
Recovery theorems concern specified states, supports, and error criteria; a noisy channel need not have a universal inverse.
09-resource-theories: A resource is defined relative to states and operations declared free.
Data processing constructs relative-entropy monotones; for coherence, \(C_r=S(\Delta\rho)-S(\rho)\).
A conversion bound is not a protocol, and catalyst return conditions must be explicit.
10-research-practicum: Benchmark a numerical method against a calculation whose answer is known.
Report resources, tolerances, assumptions, and whether a quantity is a bound or an exact value.
Research readiness includes recognizing what the evidence does not establish.
